full_text:
Lightburst is a spell that creates a dazzling firework-like display of bright sparks from the user's hand that can dazzle and disorientate opponents. 

== History == 
Sophie Casterwill used this spell to disorientate two Suits in an underground cavern. [TCG:OAL-074]

== Trivia ==
*This spell shares its name with Powerbonded Kipperin's ability, "Light Burst", which allows him to emit yellow energy to add power to an aerial tackle. [S2E30]
